_doc: Independent OFFICIAL BLAKE3 known-answer-test vectors (hash mode, unkeyed). Each SDK's runtime-vectors test loads this file and asserts its native blake3Hash reproduces `expected` byte-for-byte. These vectors are copied verbatim from the BLAKE3 team's own reference test file — they are NOT re-derived from any Runar tier. This directly guards the BUG-101 root cause (BLAKE3 previously validated only by self-produced goldens).

_source.input_pattern: byte i has value (i % 251) — a repeating 0,1,...,250,0,1,... sequence, per the official file's _comment field
_source.expected_field: first 32 bytes (64 hex chars) of the official extended `hash` output; the official _comment states implementations should check the first 32 bytes match their default-length output
_source.domain_note: Only input lengths 0..64 are vendored. Runar's blake3Hash is single-block (0..64 bytes) because Bitcoin Script is loop-free (see docs/formats/typescript.md + BUG-101). Official lengths 65,127,128,... are DELIBERATELY OMITTED — they are outside the supported single-block domain, not a coverage gap. Do not fake >64B coverage.
